change.title: Breaking API major 2026-03-25.dahlia (current supported major before Endive)

source.quote: As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features

callSites.notes: Client lazily built in getStripe (line 15); stripe export is a getter proxy. Saves customer.id.

Verifies stripe-signature via constructWebhookEvent (lib/billing/stripe.ts:252); idempotency via stripeEvent table. Handles checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.created/updated/deleted, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed.

task.notes: The repo pins Stripe API version 2025-11-17.clover on SDK 20.0.0, so nothing breaks today. Stripe versions do not expire. Dahlia is the next breaking major after Clover, so any version or SDK upgrade must review it first. On the specific Dahlia breaking items, the repo looks safe: checkout.sessions.create sets no ui_mode, it uses no Stripe.js, and it has no event destinations. One uncertainty: the webhook handler for customer.subscription.updated/deleted may read cancellation_details.reason, which gains a new retention-policy reason. The migration agent should check that before upgrading the webhook endpoint version.

record.prBody:
## Breaking API major 2026-03-25.dahlia (current supported major before Endive) [Needs review]

### Change

Moved the Stripe API pin from 2025-11-17.clover to 2026-03-25.dahlia. In lib/billing/stripe.ts the apiVersion is now '2026-03-25.dahlia'. In package.json stripe goes from ^20.0.0 to ^21.0.1, because stripe-node v21 is the major that pins Dahlia and its types would reject the new apiVersion string. The lockfile was updated by npm install. No call sites changed. Of the 11 Dahlia breaking entries, none touch this repo: it sets no ui_mode on Checkout Sessions, loads no Stripe.js or Elements, uses no event destinations or Connect capabilities, and no Issuing. The one Subscriptions item, the new retention-policy cancellation_details.reason, is not read anywhere. app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts and app/api/billing/cancel/route.ts never touch cancellation_details.

Files touched:
- `lib/billing/stripe.ts`
- `package-lock.json`
- `package.json`

### Why

The SDK pins the API version. Moving to Dahlia means stripe-node v21 plus an updated apiVersion string. Stripe lists it as a breaking major, so each entry had to be checked against how the repo uses the API.

> As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features

Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | fail (283) | fail (283) | 0 |
| build | fail (1) | fail (1) | 0 |
| test | fail (204) | fail (204) | 0 |

New failures: 0

Provider tool calls recorded by the harness:
- `stripe__stripe_api_versions`: pass
- `stripe__stripe_api_versions`: pass
- `stripe__stripe_check_params`: pass
- `stripe__stripe_check_params`: pass

The agent's validator claims (not proof; graded against the recorded calls):
- stripe__stripe_api_versions: pass (clover to dahlia lists 11 breaking entries. None apply to this repo. Filtering by 'subscription' returned 0 entries. stripe-node v21 pins 2026-03-25.dahlia.)
- stripe__stripe_check_params: pass (Checked checkout.sessions.create and subscriptions.update against the 2026-03-25.dahlia spec (v2248). No problems found. customers.create, billingPortal.sessions.create, subscriptions.cancel/retrieve and coupons.create were not run through it.)

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy

### Unproven

- Baseline typecheck, build and test were already failing because the Prisma client is not generated in the sandbox. After the change the failures are the same Prisma-related ones. I grepped the typecheck output for stripe/billing and found only Prisma export errors, so I saw no new Stripe-related type errors. I can't prove it, because the existing failures could hide one.
- Nothing was tested against Stripe's live or test API. Tests mock HTTP, so they would not catch a version-specific change in runtime behavior.
- The webhook endpoint's own api_version in the Stripe Dashboard is separate and not changed here. Existing endpoints keep delivering their current payload version until they are recreated or upgraded.
- The account default API version in Workbench was not checked.
- typecheck was already failing before the change and still fails.
- build was already failing before the change and still fails.
- test was already failing before the change and still fails.

### Behaviour changes

- Requests from the SDK are now sent with Stripe-Version 2026-03-25.dahlia instead of 2025-11-17.clover.
- Subscription responses can include a new cancellation_details.reason value for the retention policy. The code does not read that field, so it has no effect.
- The webhook handler's top-level reads of subscription current_period_start/current_period_end (app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts:211-212) were not touched. They were already stale after the Basil change that moved those fields to subscription items. This is unrelated to Dahlia and I left it alone, but it is worth a follow-up.
